method.short_text: Write a detailed essay explaining how leaves change color in autumn. Use at least 250 words and no headings.
long_passages: Deciduous trees respond to shortening days and cooler temperatures. Chlorophyll breaks down, revealing pigments that were already present in the leaf.
Maples, oaks, birches and aspens display different colors. Soil moisture and sunlight can affect how early a leaf begins to change.
Autumn field observations can compare trees on different sides of the same valley. Take notes on dates, temperatures and visible changes.
